# dissolution

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeDissolution`](gmeow-eventTypeDissolution.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeDissolution>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
